newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FAVRE, HOWARD LEAD PACKERS TO SUPER BOWL WIN OVER PATRIOTS.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FAVRE, HOWARD LEAD PACKERS TO SUPER BOWL WIN OVER PATRIOTS.

text.p: Brett Favre threw two touchdown passes and ran for another and Desmond Howard capped a spectacular day with a record 99-yard kickoff return as the Green Bay Packers beat the New England Patriots 35-21 in Super Bowl XXXI Sunday.

The victory gave the National Football League's most fabled franchise its first Super Bowl championship in 29 years as the Packers earned the trophy named for its legendary former coach Vince Lombardi.
The win also extended the NFC's domination in the Super Bowl to 13 consecutive titles.
Former Heisman trophy winner Howard became the first special teams player ever named Most Valuable Player of the Super Bowl.
Howard enjoyed a sensational, record-setting day with four kick returns for 154 yards and six punt returns for another 90 yards -- a record total of 244 return yards.
His 99-yard kickoff return for a touchdown with 3:10 left in the third quarter after the Patriots had closed to within seven points effectively ended a New England comeback.
New England quarterback Drew Bledsoe came out gunning and threw two first-quarter touchdown passes that had the Patriots leading 14-10 at one point.
But Green Bay shut down New England's running game and Bledsoe was stung by four interceptions, while Favre was not picked off once.

Favre, who was named the league's MVP this season, burned New England with two touchdown bombs, including an 81-yard strike to Antonio Freeman early in the second quarter that was the longest touchdown pass in Super Bowl history.
